title: Duplicate Order Processing
content:
Purpose: Duplicate Order Processing.

Technical details: A consumer processed webhook retries as new transactions because it did not persist event_id values. Duplicate downstream records were created.

Operational guidance: The remediation introduced idempotency checks, unique event constraints, and replay testing.

Investigation evidence: Record affected services, timestamps, correlation identifiers, observed behavior, expected behavior, recent changes, and reproducible diagnostic steps.

Verification: Compare outcomes against documented requirements. Do not claim a root cause without supporting evidence. Document unresolved uncertainty and recommended follow-up.
